title: 小智 · 体验与动效验收（最新版·独立数据）
method: Windows Computer Use Sky: fresh observed accessibility indices, one action then reobserve. First occluded screenshot discarded; explicit activation followed by actual document URL and workspace verification.
checks: entered actual production document at immutable build path
opened saved notebook: retained name and two notes
expanded teaching space then collapsed it
returned to home and retained trial window
boundary: Navigation and persisted-state inspection only. No actual user data mutation, deletion, configuration/permission changes or provider send. Native snapshots are auto-displayed in tool history; review-window.png is a separate Playwright launch capture.
